- Traveling to Haight-Ashbury (13 minutes) to meet Margaret from 11:58 AM to 12:58 PM (60 minutes, meeting the minimum).
- Traveling to The Castro (6 minutes) to meet Helen from 1:30 PM to 3:30 PM (120 minutes, meeting the minimum).
